Weekend rules for the planners
This section explains the steps that matter

Companion Animal Travel Desk Procedures

This section guides staff in handling companion animal bookings for Aurelia Skyways with steady care, clear records, and prompt follow-through from request to arrival.

Staff must review the booking details against the traveler file, confirm that the animal is eligible for transport, and record any crate or carrier notes before the trip is finalized. The agent should use calm, plain language and keep the traveler informed about the documents, handling limits, and check-in process. <<FACT F070>> When the booking includes a rabbit, the agent must place that requirement in the file and avoid casual promises that conflict with the animal safety review.

Health paperwork must be checked before acceptance, and the file must show that the original document was reviewed and accepted without alteration. <<FACT F083>> If a bird record is incomplete, the booking must not move forward until the missing item is resolved through the proper channel. Staff should not guess at validity, and they should not advise the traveler to rely on memory or on a prior trip record.

At the airport, the desk should compare the companion animal to the approved booking, confirm the carrier condition, and make sure the traveler understands where the animal will be handed over and returned. If the traveler raises a concern, the agent should listen, restate the concern clearly, and offer the next step without argument. Any exception, delay, or transfer in care must be written in the record so the boarding team and arrival team can follow the same plan.
